source: Gary's Drive · Health folder · older-format essay (SPM Essay: The Importance of Keeping Healthy)
paragraphs: In today's hectic world, maintaining good health is not that easy. We often forgot to take care of our health, and focus more on our studies and work.

Keeping healthy can ensure us a happy life without the need to worry about our health. Furthermore, it deters us from any disease and illness. We will have an active and full life. We can also ensure a better quality of life when we are older.

To stay healthy, we should eat healthy food and eat at an appropriate time. Avoid eating junk food and eating late. Besides, we should exercise regularly. It can enhance our physical fitness and guarantee mental health.
If we do not keep healthy, we can add stress to our life. Health problems will also start to appear and we will have a difficult time living and be happy.
On the whole, keeping healthy is important to everyone as we can get a lot of benefits.
